hook.name: LaunchHook
hook.description: A shared Uniswap v4 hook for launchpad-created pools that gates pool creation to the factory, locks all liquidity (blocking third-party adds/removes), and charges time-decaying anti-snipe fees on swaps. Fees are split into configurable per-pool components (creator, platform, referrer) and distributed via ERC-6909 claims to a FeeEscrow contract.
